items.title: No road markings on Hatherley Lane at the Arle Court Roundabout. If approaching the Arle Court roundabout from the direction of the Harvester, there are 2 lanes at the roundabout. I have been involved in multiple near misses where nobody knows what lane to be in. It would be good if there could be painted markings in the lane to identify whether the left lane is for the first 3 exits and the right lane is for Arle Court only.
